theorems.name: Submission.lpf_wtc_weighted_tangent_transfer
theorems.statement: ∀ (Q n : ℕ) (M C : Set (Eucl Q)) (θ : Eucl Q → ℝ) (y : Eucl Q) (T : Submodule ℝ (Eucl Q)), NullMeasurableSet M (μHE[n] : Measure (Eucl Q)) → NullMeasurableSet C (μHE[n] : Measure (Eucl Q)) → C ⊆ M → y ∈ C → (∀ x ∈ M, 0 ≤ θ x) → Poincare.SimonGMT.Chapter03.HasApproximateTangentSpaceAt n C y T → (∃ r : ℝ, 0 < r ∧ (μHE[n] : Measure (Eucl Q)) (C ∩ closedBall y r) < ∞ ∧ IntegrableOn θ (M ∩ closedBall y r) (μHE[n] : Measure (Eucl Q))) → ContinuousWithinAt θ C y → Tendsto (fun ρ : ℝ => (∫⁻ x in (M \ C) ∩ closedBall y ρ, ENNReal.ofReal (θ x) ∂(μHE[n] : Measure (Eucl Q))) / ENNReal.ofReal (ρ ^ n)) (𝓝[>] 0) (𝓝 0) → HasWeightedApproximateTangentSpaceAt n M θ y T
